Resolves #20953

Removes the one-time heads-up run after its use: the workflow file, `decideHeadsUp`, the `OPT_OUT` constant, the `place` parameter of `renderBadge`, and the two spec blocks with their helpers. `headsUpMarker` and the check in `decideMergeComment` stay, because 114 pull requests carry the marker for good and a merge comment must post nothing underneath one. The diff removes 664 lines and adds 10.

Evidence: L2 (the module's spec in CI, plus a static search with its control) → L2 required (no criterion needs a live surface). No residuals.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | The record: https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20892#issuecomment-6884761188 (114 notes, none failed, no further run planned) |
| AC-2 | outside-CI: the search and its control (Test Evidence) |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `contributorStanding.spec.mjs` › "a bot-authored marker of either kind stops a re-run, and a pasted one does not" |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: the module's spec. Gone with the code: `OPT_OUT` (module and spec), `place`, the spec's `headsUp` helper and its `BOT` constant |

## Deltas from ticket

- The search of the second criterion finds one line, not none: `HEADS_UP_PREFIX = '<!-- contributor-heads-up:'`, the marker's own text, which stays with the marker. The criterion in the ticket now says so.
- The spec's `BOT` constant goes too; only the removed blocks used it.

## Test Evidence

- `git grep -n -E "decideHeadsUp|contributor-heads-up" -- .github buildScripts test` at the head: one hit, the marker prefix in `buildScripts/util/contributorStanding.mjs`. Control: the same search for `decideMergeComment` finds it in all three trees.
